living_entity_knockback.strength_scale: strength * (1 - knockback_resistance); nothing happens when the result is <= 0
living_entity_knockback.vertical: on ground: min(vertical_cap, motion_y / 2 + strength); airborne: motion_y unchanged

hurt_direction.direction_is: vector from the victim toward the damage source, so the victim is pushed away
hurt_direction.projectile: the projectile's horizontal delta movement, negated
hurt_direction.other: damage source position (the direct entity's position) minus the victim's position

living_entity_knockback.knockback_only_when: hurtServer applied damage, DamageTypeTags.NO_KNOCKBACK is absent, and the hit was not fully blocked

attack_knockback.direction: attacker yaw: x = sin(yaw), z = -cos(yaw); the victim is pushed along its facing

mob_melee.extra: getKnockback = attack_knockback attribute / 2 (weapon enchantment applies), along the attacker's yaw

hoglin_throw.formula: strength = attack_knockback - resistance (nothing when <= 0); horizontal = normalize(dx, 0, dz) * strength * (nextFloat * 0.5 + 0.2) turned by yRot(nextInt(21) - 10) in radians; vertical = strength * nextFloat * 0.5; added to the victim's motion after the default hurt knockback

arrow_knockback.horizontal_direction: the arrow's horizontal delta movement, normalized
arrow_knockback.default_knockback: the 0.4 hurt knockback along the arrow's horizontal motion

knockback.after: the victim's own 0.4 hurt knockback from the attacker's position

sweep_attack.particle_position: (attacker x - sin(yaw), attacker y + 0.5 * height, attacker z + cos(yaw))
